create_non_max_suppression: create non maximum suppression to prune overlapping bounding boxes and masks by IOU threshold
create_multi_class_non_max_suppression: create multi-class non maximum suppression that independently selects top boxes per class
run_iou_computation: run pairwise intersection-over-union computation between two box mask lists
run_prune_non_overlapping_masks: run pruning of boxes whose masks overlap less than a minimum threshold with another box mask list
create_gather_boxes: create gather operation to select boxes and masks from a box mask list by index
